decisionHistory.title: Media owns the media product; Shared/Kernel/Ghatana retain public primitives; no hidden cross-repository implementation imports
Initial proposal to move neutral experience-recorder core toward Tools; keep product-specific GharBatai scenarios separate
decisionHistory.disposition: HISTORICAL_DIRECTION_SUPERSEDED_BY_LATER_OWNER_BOUNDARY: Media owns capture mechanics; GharBatai neutral recorder candidate; Tools owns generic Product Definition/Experience, not a duplicate runtime

decisionHistory.title: Initial capture strategy: Chromium DevTools screen recording preferred when reliably supported; Playwright screencast/video practical fallback; screenshots diagnostic not final film
decisionHistory.disposition: EVALUATION_PRIORITY_ONLY; verify browser API/output MP4 and host compatibility

decisionHistory.title: Selective reuse of VoiceStudio and Voicebox ideas; prohibit copying AGPL VoiceStudio or GPL Pedalboard into permissive Media bundle
Media Recorder/Studio, Declarative Animation, Declarative Simulation first-class; TutorPutor owns science and pedagogy; Media owns rendering, artifacts and UI
PDP-3 defines demoable scenarios with narration and realistic static fixtures; later Build recreates the same semantic outcome from real product effects
All new Media backend implementation belongs in ghatana-media; legacy ghatana/services/media remains read-only source until authorized one-writer cutover
macOS ARM64 and Linux ARM64 functional verification; Windows-only platform tasks deferred; Linux cgroup-backed worker for untrusted media on both hosts
Whisper tiny, Piper LJSpeech medium, YOLOX Nano are R9 candidate asset references for initial STT/TTS/Vision qualification; no inference of provider or copyright admission
